roundWindowContract.check: After physics or zero-step real frame: first dead detection sets roundOver and returns; later frames add unscaled real dt; >3.5s pauses and stops input/physics.
roundWindowContract.scale: 1 before roundOver; .5 afterward. 120Hz virtual real frames, native DT fixed. Max18 real seconds.
roundWindowContract.limitations: Main calls checkRoundEnd once per rAF with clamped real dt, after all physics; decisive slowMo(.25), hitStop(.12) and variable rAF are not emulated. This is lifecycle-equivalent detection/pause bookkeeping with a conservative post-death physics-time upper bound, not browser-exact replay. External hand/tap script remains on physics clock and writes at physics input phase.

spinMetric: Sum abs(world sword omega dot post-step blade unit axis)*1/120. Angular-velocity projection, not wrist-relative twist, signed net orientation, or integral of commanded plane rotation.
interpretation: All six held strokes reduce after-stop absolute blade-axis spin; most axis-direction metrics barely change, some worsen.
Runtime/research exact and observer checks establish implementation/instrumentation parity, not human acceptance.
Contact trajectories differ in actual combat, so health/outcomes are not same-hit comparisons.
Both isolated runs have zero clashes/wounds. Real tap is accepted; tap-free counterpart still has worse direction-change peaks and spin.
Release and hold have identical dynamics in measured skill0 conditions; this is a different handHeld flag, not an independent physical replication.
Raw files are local outside Git and absent from Git bundle. No user mobile test or public deployment.
